Questions about Alpha Progression?
Still need help?
Email info@alphaprogression.com , or ask existing users on Reddit or Facebook .
Can Alpha Progression create a workout plan tailored to me?
Alpha Progression Pro builds a complete plan around your goal, experience, available equipment, training frequency and preferred workout duration.
You can also prioritize specific muscles.
The app selects your split, exercises, sets and rep targets, and you can adjust everything afterward.
Whether you prefer full-body training, upper/lower or push/pull/legs, your plan can fit the way you want to train.
Learn how the plan generator works .
How does Alpha Progression decide what weight and reps I should do?

Alpha Progression Pro uses your previous performance, the sets you've completed in your current workout, your planned targets and your available weights to recommend a weight and rep count for each working set.
If the next dumbbell is too big a jump, it can suggest more reps first.
Recommendations adapt to what you actually log, including when you perform below expectations.
They become available once you've recorded previous performance for that exercise.
Learn how progression recommendations work .
How is Alpha Progression different from other workout apps?
Alpha Progression combines a workout tracker, personalized training plans and specific weight and rep recommendations in one app built for muscle growth and strength.
Your plan keeps a consistent exercise structure while weight and rep recommendations adapt to your performance.
You can also build your own routine and choose which guidance to use.
The focus is on making consistent training and measurable progress easier.
Explore our workout-app comparisons .
Is Alpha Progression suitable for beginners and experienced lifters?
Beginners can use Pro to get a plan suited to their experience and follow exercise videos and step-by-step instructions as they learn.
Experienced lifters can customize their training, prioritize muscles and use detailed progress charts and advanced programming tools.
You can also start with free workout logging and add more guidance when you need it.
Alpha Progression can grow with your training experience.
Can I follow my own workout plan and change exercises?
You can build your own plan for free, recreate a coach's routine or edit a plan generated by Alpha Progression Pro.
Change exercises, their order, sets and rep targets to suit you.
If a machine is occupied, you can swap the exercise just for today's workout or keep the change in your plan.
Pro's progression recommendations also work with manually created plans.
Do I need to understand RIR or periodization to use Alpha Progression?
No.
With Pro, you can follow a generated plan and receive weight and rep recommendations without using either.
RIR means "reps in reserve": how many more clean reps you think you could have completed.
Periodization lets training targets vary across several weeks.
Both are optional Pro features, along with deloads (easier phases of training).
Start simple and enable them whenever you want more control.
Can I use Alpha Progression at home or in different gyms?
Tell Alpha Progression which equipment you have, and the Pro plan generator will choose exercises for that setup.
Configure your available weights so progression recommendations reflect the loads you can actually use.
With Pro, you can save separate profiles for your regular gym, home gym or a gym you visit while traveling, each with its own equipment and weights.
Can I generate a single workout instead of a full plan?
Alpha Progression Pro can generate an individual workout for an extra session, a trip or a day when you want to train outside your usual plan.
Choose a full-body, upper-body or lower-body workout and narrow the focus if you like, or let the app suggest a focus based on recent workouts.
You can edit the result and use progression recommendations as usual.
Does Alpha Progression work offline?
You can follow your plans, log workouts and, with Pro, receive progression recommendations without an internet connection.
Exercise videos are also available offline in a lower resolution.
An internet connection is needed to generate a new plan or individual workout.
If you're signed into your Alpha Progression account, your training data syncs automatically when you're back online.
Is Alpha Progression free, and what does Pro add?
The permanent free version includes unlimited workout logging, manually created plans, exercise videos, a rest timer, body measurements and CSV export.
All without ads.
Pro adds personalized plan and workout generation, progression recommendations, charts, multiple gym profiles and advanced training tools.

Who is the app for?
Anyone who wants to get stronger, build muscle, or just lift weights consistently.
It works equally well for first-time gym-goers building a routine and ten-year veterans chasing the next PR.
The training principles are also explicitly suitable for all genders and ages.
For a broader overview, see our comparisons of strength training apps and muscle-building apps .
Is the app for beginners, or just experienced lifters?
Both equally.
Beginners get a science-backed starter plan, sensible progression, and zero programming jargon to learn first.
Experienced lifters get a customizable program that respects their level.
Periodization, RIR, deloads.
You don't grow out of the app as you grow stronger.
Our app comparisons for beginners and advanced lifters explain the differences in guidance and flexibility.
Can I use it at home, or in a hotel gym?
When you set up your plan, you tell us what equipment you have access to and we only program exercises you can actually do.
You can also save multiple gym profiles, e.g.
"Main gym", "Home", or "Hotel".
When you switch gyms, the app knows what weights to recommend.
Compare strength training apps for home gyms .
Are the plans and recommendations actually science-based?
Yes, and we take this seriously.
As experienced lifters with academic backgrounds and trainer certifications, our founding team has been studying the relevant literature for years.
Our algorithm is built on peer-reviewed exercise science.
Meta-analyses on volume, intensity, RIR, frequency, and periodization, instead of bro-science or influencer trends.
Can I build my own program?
Yes, top to bottom.
Use our plan generator as a starting point and edit anything, or build your plan from scratch.
Choose your split, exercises, set and rep counts, RIR, and intensity techniques like dropsets or supersets.
If you want to mix things up, you can also do one-off workouts.
Our workout planner comparison covers both manual planning and automated plan generation .
How's the algorithm different from Strong or Hevy?
Strong and Hevy are capable workout trackers.
Hevy Trainer also generates plans and increases weights based on your performance within prescribed rep ranges.
Alpha Progression Pro recommends a specific weight and rep count for every set, based on your actual performance and the weights available in your gym.
Our plan generator connects that progression with your muscle priorities, optional RIR targets, periodization, and deloads.
How does Alpha Progression compare to Fitbod?
Fitbod generates a fresh workout each session based on your recent training.
Alpha Progression keeps a stable, structured plan, and progresses you set by set within it.
The trade-off: Fitbod is more flexible day to day, AP gives you a program you can stick to for months and watch lifts climb.
The structured approach is what most hypertrophy and strength research supports.
Is the Free version usable, or just a teaser?
Genuinely usable, forever, no card needed.
You get full workout logging, the complete 795 exercises with form videos, and body measurement tracking.
Pro then unlocks the parts of the app that take real engineering to provide: the algorithm, the custom plan generator, and the analytics.
Our gym tracker comparison also covers what other apps include for free.
Can I try the Pro version for free?
The yearly Pro plan starts with a 14-day free trial.
If you need more time, you can subscribe for a single month, and either cancel or upgrade to the cheaper yearly plan.
How can I cancel?
If you subscribed in the app, cancel from your App Store or Google Play subscription settings.
If you subscribed on the website, head to our update subscription page and we'll email you a link to the customer portal.
Either way you keep Pro until the end of your current period, with no immediate cutoff.
The founding team has years in personal training experience, and even some in competitive bodybuilding.
With academic background, we are well-versed interpreting the latest exercise research.
We started Alpha Progression to bring this knowledge to as many lifters as possible for a small price compared to one-on-one coaching.
We are an agile small team with no VC pressure, focused on supporting your training journey, instead of growth at all cost.
